summary.text: Daoist Countless Treasures is a Medieval Antiquity Era rank eight Gu Immortal who fused a yellow heaven fragment into his grotto-heaven and formed treasure yellow heaven.

claims.text: Fang Yuan first meets the name when Little Hu Immortal opens connecting heaven Gu onto treasure yellow heaven and narration explains how that empty market world began in the Medieval Antiquity Era. The grotto-heaven shown has no mountains, trees, rivers, birds, beasts, worms, or fish, only precious treasures, including the sole rank eight Immortal Gu treasure light Gu. Treasure light Gu assesses value by brightness and can also search for treasure, though its range is small and often needs other Gu to extend detection.

The same origin passage has him acquire a yellow heaven fragment by chance, fuse it into his grotto-heaven, and form treasure yellow heaven. He used Immortal Gu treasure light to find countless treasures, and over time gained the reputation and title “Countless Treasures”.

A later appraisal stretch calls treasure yellow heaven’s owner, Daoist Countless Treasure who owned treasure light Gu, the most authoritative and accomplished appraiser Gu Immortal in history, while still limiting his accuracy on fake Qian Kun Crystal Wall stone slabs to seventy to eighty percent.

Later talk again names him treasure yellow heaven’s owner and restates that he unexpectedly obtained a yellow heaven fragment world, fused it into his grotto-heaven, and formed treasure yellow heaven, which then continued existing to the present as the biggest trading area in the Gu Immortal world. The same stretch explains that once a grotto-heaven absorbs a nine heavens fragment it roots into the greater world, cannot return into the Gu Immortal’s body, and can greatly weaken or erase calamities and tribulations, with treasure yellow heaven offered as the example that never faces them.

Treasure yellow heaven came from him. After him there were no successors, and even many Immortal Venerables and Demon Venerables could not find its exact location. Since he created it, the market had been open for three hundred thousand years and become the biggest help toward Gu Immortal cultivation. Knowing he could not survive a coming tribulation, he used his immortal aperture to absorb a small fragment world of immemorial yellow heaven and form treasure yellow heaven; he was trapped inside and lost his freedom, but no longer faced tribulations.
